archetype: Obsidian Security Command Center (Enterprise SIEM & Threat Hunting Platform)

design_philosophy.core: Tactical Minimalism & High Density Information Architecture
design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Dark-first enterprise SOC interface built for maximum data scanning, zero distraction, and precise cognitive ergonomics.
anti_patterns: No rounded-3xl or rounded-2xl giant cards
No decorative cartoon 3D illustrations or generic AI SaaS glossy gradients
No unnecessary scroll padding or oversized whitespace
No Inter font for code/JSON/queries (MUST use Monospace for technical values)
No default un-tinted pure transparent popovers or headers

body.sizes: text-xs (12px) to text-sm (14px) for maximum density

technical_data.usage: IP addresses, Hashes, Hashes, Timestamps, Query Editor, Raw JSON, ECS fields

sidebar.position: fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-64 md:w-60
components: SentinelLab Shield Brand Logo with glow border
Main Navigation: Overview, Events Explorer, Threat Hunting, Alerts, Detection Rules, Sources & Ingestion, Investigations, Reports, Settings
Quick Action: Live Telemetry Feed indicator

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, switches, dropdown items) have precise kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT change the layout density to huge roomy cards — keep cell padding tight (`py-1.5 px-3` or `py-2 px-3`) for true SOC SIEM density.
Implement the 4 theme modes in state/CSS variables or Tailwind classes (Obsidian Dark as default).
Use Lucide icons for all tactical UI icons (Shield, AlertTriangle, Terminal, Activity, FileText, Cpu, Key, Eye, Lock, RefreshCw, Search, Download).
Ensure Demo Mode toggle in Settings generates live periodic telemetry events into the global store so charts and tables feel active.
Provide rich mock data with realistic IP addresses (e.g. 192.168.1.105, 10.0.4.12, 185.220.101.5), SHA256 hashes, MITRE technique tags (T1059, T1078), and ECS JSON log structures.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_requirement: Strict WCAG AA / APCA compliance for dark dark background and high severity alert badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_state_rule: Always explicitly define hover text and border colors (e.g., hover:border-cyan-500/50 hover:bg-slate-800/60).
